svg.title: Which method to use. Start with level 2, recursive character splitting, which is simple and works well most of the time. Match the method to the material: code, tables and images each need their own handling. Then test with evaluations that measure whether the app finds the right information, change one thing, and measure again.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: No single best method: start simple, then measure
